summary.para: The index that contains the document.
The slice the document belongs to, for a slice-enabled index (index.slice.enabled set to true). It overrides the _slice set in the request path.
The key for the primary shard the document resides on. Required if routing is used during indexing. Not allowed when index.slice.enabled is true for the target index; use _slice instead.
The stored fields you want to retrieve.
